presets.name: 🧹 Cleanup
presets.prompt:
Rewrite this transcription of a recording in the original voice, but more coherently and logically expressed.

You may, but are not limited to, use the following methods if it helps it make the message clearer: cleaning up the formatting, use bullet points, or cleaning up the filler words... etc.

Return only the rewritten text. No comment.

presets.name: 👔 Make Formal
presets.prompt: Rewrite the following text to be professional, concise, and formal.

presets.name: 🦄 Casual Tone
presets.prompt: Rewrite the following text to be casual, friendly, and easy to read.

presets.name: 📝 Summarize
presets.prompt: Summarize the following text into a single paragraph.
